title: Final Melody
body: This is your capstone: a full G major melody spanning the complete range you've practised. It uses leaps, stepwise runs, and a satisfying return to the home chord G-B-D-G. Take it slow — every note counts.

title: The Full Arc
caption: The melody opens with a broken G chord leaping up to G5 — a full octave and a half. It then spirals down in waves. The journey away from home and back is the shape of almost every great melody.
